data.revised_prompt: High-fidelity desktop web app direction comp for a Chinese A-share stock evaluation dashboard, 1536x1024 landscape, exceptional craft quality, restrained blue-white financial product UI, fine borders, disciplined data typography, highly polished spacing and hierarchy, daily work clarity, no device mockup, no watermark, no marketing hero. Layout: top navigation bar and stock summary header; left two-thirds contains hard filters and score modules; right side sticky conclusion card; lower fold visible. Visual style: crisp fintech dashboard, subtle grid, white background with pale blue surfaces (#F7F9FC), dark blue-gray text (#142B3A), accent blue (#3B82F6), green status (#22A06B), red status (#D64545). Include exact visible text: 'Glacier Signal', '贵州茅台', '600519.SH', '等待转强', '候选评分 71 / 100', '硬性过滤', '技术评分', '风险预算', '结构止损 ¥1,198.00'. Right sticky conclusion card should prominently show '等待转强', large '71/100', '结构止损 ¥1,198.00', and position inputs area. Left panel should show hard filters as compact toggle rows/cards with green/red symbols, then technical score modules with clear charts/indicators and numerical rows. Ensure category-standard Chinese stock analysis dashboard, clean professional spacing, fine dividers, excellent typography, no invented claims.
